book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù gɛ̀ kɛme fiŋwa ba gwenyɛ
Ŋka n'yɛŋ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wumu wù tɛɛme le wu shiide wu too fɛwe, kimbɛ baŋɛ wu njɛ nju, kila daa a kikwɛɛ ke we. Bvushi bwe gɛ̀ bee njɛ juu, bikaa bie nyume njɛ lɛmɛ chi ŋgu fɛ chi bɛɛne.
Wu gɛ̀ kɛme fiŋwa fimi a wu bo ba gwenyɛ. Wu shii wu tome kikaa ke kinchiɛɛŋ yi joo yì baaŋ le, wu tome kiŋkoŋo yi nshɛŋ le.
No wu tome noo, wu jaŋɛ fɛwɛɛwe njɛ bvule fɛ wu wanɛ. No wu jaŋɛ noo, jaŋ yì to yi ŋgbwame kiŋgane kinsooshwi mo yi jɛmɛ.

No jaŋ yì to yi ŋgbwame kiŋgane kinsooshwi yiyu jɛme noo, mɛ mo tu ŋgoone kinsaŋ fiɛɛ fì yi gɛ̀ jɛme, geenɛ jɛ yimi jɛmɛ mɛne fɛwe lɛ, “Gɛ̂lɛ fiɛɛ fì jaŋ yì ŋgbwame kiŋgane kinsooshwi yinɛ jɛme a shɛŋ. Keefɛ wo sâŋ a ŋwa le gɛ.”
Nchɛndaa wù ŋgɛ̀ n'yɛŋ wu lɛme yi joo yì baaŋ le mo yi nshɛŋ le wɛɛ wu chiaasɛ kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ we,

wu kaŋ jee chi muh wɛɛ wù le yu segechii wu kage gɛ, nyu wu wù gɛ̀ fɛ kibvulɛ bɛ mwɛɛ munchii mu yiyu le, mo nshɛŋ bɛ mwɛɛ munchii mu le yu le, mo joo yì baaŋ bɛ mwɛɛ munchii mù nyume yo. Wu kaŋ wu jɛme lɛ, “Gɛ Nyo baaŋ wu chîide lo ye ki wu gê fiɛɛ fì wu goone ki wu gê gɛ.
Le ge nyûme aju a nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kinsooshwi lé wu gê wu tôŋ che soŋ, Nyo gê fiɛɛ fì wu nyile fi to fi kojɛ no wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa bamii be ba lɛme le bò le bamii be ba ntuŋ le.”
Jɛ yì ŋgɛ̀ yu wa fɛwe yɛɛ ka yi jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, “Gɛ̂nɛ wo fî fiŋwa fì ba gwenyɛ fiɛɛ a kibo ki nchɛndaa wu Nyo wɛɛ wù lɛme yi joo yì baaŋ le bɛ yi nshɛŋ le.”
Mɛ mo ŋgɛɛŋ fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wuyu le njɛmɛ lɛ wu nya fiŋwa fiyu mɛne. Wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, “Kô wo jî. Wu ge doo wu boh a wo shɛŋ wu luji lo. Geenɛ, wu lé wu gê wu njɛ̂ŋe a wo mu njɛ bvutu.”
Mɛ mo nfi fiŋwa fiyu a kibo ki nchɛndaa wu Nyo wuyu le, nji. No ŋgɛ̀ jii, wu njɛŋe a mɛ mu njɛ bvutu. Geenɛ sege wu gɛ̀ boh wa a shɛŋ wu tu wu luji lo.
No nji wa, bo mo bo jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, “Wo kɛme ki wo ka wo fêjɛ ntuŋ wu Nyo bamii le. Ntuŋ wunɛ le kune chikfuu chi bamii bɛ bituŋ mo bamii ba jɛme chikfuu chi jɛ́ mo banfoŋ.”
